DESCRIPTION: Verify system prevents SQL injection in username
TEST STEPS: 1. Open login page 2. Enter SQL payload in username 3. Enter any password 4. Click Login

DESCRIPTION: Verify system prevents SQL injection in password
TEST STEPS: 1. Open login page 2. Enter valid username 3. Enter SQL payload in password 4. Click Login

DESCRIPTION: Verify system blocks repeated failed login attempts
TEST STEPS: 1. Enter wrong password repeatedly 2. Observe system behavior

DESCRIPTION: Verify system rejects weak passwords
TEST STEPS: 1. Enter valid username 2. Enter weak password 3. Click Login

DESCRIPTION: Verify password characters are masked
TEST STEPS: 1. Open login page 2. Type password 3. Observe masking

DESCRIPTION: Verify session expires after inactivity
TEST STEPS: 1. Login 2. Stay idle for timeout duration 3. Attempt navigation

DESCRIPTION: Verify secure pages cannot be accessed after logout
TEST STEPS: 1. Logout 2. Press browser back arrow
EXPECTED: Dashboard should NOT load; Redirect to login
COMMENTS: User reported issue: back button loads previous page

DESCRIPTION: Verify sensitive pages are not cached
TEST STEPS: 1. Login 2. Navigate to Home/Profile/Fees 3. Logout 4. Press back button
EXPECTED: No cached data; Redirect to login

DESCRIPTION: Verify session cookies cannot be reused
TEST STEPS: 1. Login 2. Copy session cookie 3. Logout 4. Paste cookie in new tab
